subject: Executive intro + demo — aligning VP/CIO attendance and timing

Subject: Executive intro + demo — proposed windows for Nov 17-18

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the interest and for looping in Alex. We’d love to run a focused executive introduction + product demo for your CIO/VP leadership. To make it high-value for the execs we propose: a 30-minute executive highlight (business outcomes + risk/compliance touchpoints) followed by an optional 30–40 minute deep-dive for your engineering/ML leads.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Nov 17 — 11:00–12:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed Nov 18 — 09:30–10:30 or 15:00–16:00

Please let me know which slot works best for your CIO and VP. If you prefer a single 45-minute window we can compress the exec portion into 20 minutes and move the rest to Q&A.

I’m copying Naomi (solutions lead) and Karthik (technical sponsor) so they can align availability and prep materials. We have a one-page exec deck and an optional architecture appendix we can attach.

Thanks,
David
